Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, resolutions, and troubleshooting processes. Escalation Management Work with the Escalations Team to escalate complex issues when first-line troubleshooting does not resolve the problem. Collaborate with other departments (Product, Engineering, Success) to ensure comprehensive issue resolution. Skills & Qualifications: Technical Expertise: Proficiency in operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux) and common software applications. Strong understanding of network configurations, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), and hardware components. Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote troubleshooting tools. Technically inclined with the ability to understand and work with APIs, integrations, and data flows between systems. Comfortable reading and interpreting light code (e.G., JSON, HTML, basic scripting) to diagnose issues, troubleshoot integrations, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams. Curious and adaptable, with a desire to learn new tools, technologies, and platforms quickly. Problem-solving Ability: An analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues quickly. Capable of working under pressure and handling multiple tasks simultaneously. Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users. Strong customer service skills with a focus on user satisfaction. Organizational Skills: Detail-oriented, with strong documentation and record-keeping abilities. Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment. Preferred Experience: Previous experience in a help desk, IT support, or technical support role. Knowledge of cloud-based services (e.G., AWS, Azure) and virtualization technologies. Experience with troubleshooting mobile devices (Android, iOS). Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or automation concepts (hands-on experience a plus, but not required). Comfort reviewing technical documentation or light code to support troubleshooting and collaboration with engineering teams. Previous work with an American company Education & Certifications: Formal education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not required. Equivalent experience gained through professional work, certifications, technical training programs, or self-study is highly valued. Continuous learning mindset, with interest in understanding APIs, integrations, and modern SaaS platforms. Who You Are: A solid technical aptitude - we love tech support backgrounds or a history of self-started technical growth. You're an empathetic self-starter who loves technology and enjoys helping others to successfully use it - this isn't run-of-the-mill customer service, we strive for the Melt Your Face experience! We represent the human side of Drip Passion for helping others internally and externally Impeccable written and verbal communication and strong attention to detail In addition, we give bonus points for having a SaaS or Ecommerce background!

title: Engineer Manager
description: ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. THE ROLE The Manager I of Engineering plays a key leadership role, directly managing a small team of software engineers. This role is responsible for ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software projects, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture, and supporting the professional growth of engineers. In addition to leading day-to-day execution, this manager contributes to tactical decision-making, participates in architectural discussions, and ensures engineering efforts are aligned with project goals. They collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver solutions that support Syniti’s broader mission. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Manage and support a team of software engineers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope. - Provide coaching, mentorship, and regular performance feedback to support individual growth. - Guide the team in applying engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and secure development. - Participate in architectural and technical design discussions, ensuring sound engineering decisions. - Collaborate closely with product and cross-functional teams to align priorities and deliver value. - Help shape a positive and inclusive team culture that fosters engagement, learning, and innovation. - Identify and address delivery risks, blockers, or process gaps within the team’s scope. - Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new engineers, and support team scaling efforts. WHAT IT TAKES - Proven experience as a team lead or first-line engineering manager in a software development environment. - Strong technical foundation in modern software development (e.G., C#, Go, React, TypeScript, AWS). - Familiarity with agile development methodologies, DevOps practices, and software delivery processes. - Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders. - Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and support the growth of engineering team members. - Experience participating in technical design, architecture reviews, and secure development practices. - Comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed, and cross-functional environment. Be fully aligned to our core values: - Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. - Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. - Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. - Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. WHAT WE OFFER - Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style. - Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. - Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. - Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all. - Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. - An open organisation. Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued. Our Commitment to Inclusion At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

Management of various business environments & path codes like development, user acceptance testing (UAT) and production, making sure each environment has relevant privileges for users to work with objects in OMW along with required OCM Mapping and Datasources. Development of software tools and processes to automate repetitive CNC tasks Refreshing and optimization of the underlying database, working with database administrators Experience/expertise with SQL databases such as Oracle, SQL Server with regards to EnterpriseOne Adherence to Redfaire and client Data Protection policies. Qualifications & Skills: Technical Experience: Minimum 6-7 Years of JDE CNC experience. Expertise in the technical architecture for EnterpriseOne (e.G. Citrix servers, WebLogic servers, WebSphere servers, deployment server, batch/enterprise servers, BSSV servers, mobile apps/AIS servers plus multiple OS's including Windows, Unix/Linux & AS400 can be advantageous) Experience in adding custom environments and custom datasource setups Knowledge of CNC mapping configuration changes using Object Configuration Manager (OCM) Expertise in multiple JDE system software configurations (multi-foundation), Tools Release Updates Relevant 3rd level qualification or equivalent. Excellent communication skills, both verbal & written. Technical competence with proven analytical skills. Problem solving and trouble shooting skills (which requires a wide range of skills beyond JDE CNC skills such as networking, storage, database, operating system, and virtual infrastructures and the ability to work with people who are experts in these areas) Systematic approach to problem resolution. Ability to work independently under one’s own initiative whilst being part of a global team. Proven ability to be adaptable and to respond to constantly changing demands. Ability to work under pressure & to prioritize. Recognise the importance of customer service and strive to deliver high standards. Working knowledge of Microsoft products such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook. What we offer: Career growth within an expanding global award-winning Oracle Partner recognised for excellence. title: Ai & Innovation Experience Designer
description: AI & Innovation Experience Designer About the Role We are seeking an AI & Innovation Experience Designer to help define the next generation of intelligent commerce experiences. This role will focus on conceptualizing and designing new AI-powered capabilities and hyper-personalized shopping journeys for a large-scale digital marketplace platform. You will own the AI Tools and Hyper-Personalization workstreams, exploring how generative AI, advanced data models, and intelligent systems can transform how customers discover products, interact with sellers, and navigate digital retail environments. This role requires a designer who is comfortable operating in ambiguity and enjoys shaping 0-to-1 product concepts. You will translate emerging technologies into compelling user experiences through prototypes, concept designs, and future-state product visions. What You’ll Do Conceptualize new AI-powered commerce experiences across search, discovery, and personalized shopping journeys. Design innovative features powered by generative AI and machine learning, such as contextual search, personalized product detail pages, AI-generated retail media, and intelligent seller tools. Explore how data and personalization models can create dynamic, hyper-personalized user experiences throughout the shopping lifecycle. Develop concept prototypes and design explorations that communicate future product possibilities and inspire product leadership. Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and data teams to translate AI capabilities into meaningful user experiences. Present forward-looking concepts and design narratives to stakeholders, helping shape the long-term product vision. Operate within a fast-paced consulting environment with short delivery cycles and evolving requirements. Required Qualifications 5+ years of experience in product design or UX design, with exposure to emerging technologies or innovation-focused work Experience designing AI-powered or data-driven product experiences Strong conceptual thinking and ability to design future-state product concepts Ability to communicate complex ideas through prototypes, visual concepts, and design storytelling Understanding of personalization systems, recommendation engines, or conversational AI patterns Comfort working in ambiguous, early-stage product environments Fluency in Portuguese (required working language) Ability to work effectively in fast-paced consulting environments Preferred Qualifications Experience designing GenAI-powered features, including conversational interfaces, AI search, content generation, or recommendation systems Familiarity with retail media platforms, seller tools, or marketplace ecosystems Experience designing for conversational commerce platforms such as messaging-based shopping experiences Exposure to or interest in the Brazilian or Latin American technology ecosystem This role is ideal for a designer who enjoys exploring the intersection of AI, commerce, and product innovation. If you’re excited about shaping intelligent, personalized digital experiences and pushing the boundaries of what modern e-commerce can become, we’d love to connect.

title: Engineer Manager
description:
ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world's largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti's Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti's award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data. Syniti's cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. THE ROLE The Manager I of Engineering plays a key leadership role, directly managing a small team of software engineers. This role is responsible for ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software projects, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture, and supporting the professional growth of engineers. In addition to leading day-to-day execution, this manager contributes to tactical decision-making, participates in architectural discussions, and ensures engineering efforts are aligned with project goals. They collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver solutions that support Syniti's broader mission. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Manage and support a team of software engineers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.
- Provide coaching, mentorship, and regular performance feedback to support individual growth.
- Guide the team in applying engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and secure development.
- Participate in architectural and technical design discussions, ensuring sound engineering decisions.
- Collaborate closely with product and cross-functional teams to align priorities and deliver value.
- Help shape a positive and inclusive team culture that fosters engagement, learning, and innovation.
- Identify and address delivery risks, blockers, or process gaps within the team's scope.
- Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new engineers, and support team scaling efforts. WHAT IT TAKES - Proven experience as a team lead or first-line engineering manager in a software development environment.
- Strong technical foundation in modern software development (e.G., C#, Go, React, TypeScript, AWS).
- Familiarity with agile development methodologies, DevOps practices, and software delivery processes.
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and support the growth of engineering team members.
- Experience participating in technical design, architecture reviews, and secure development practices.
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed, and cross-functional environment. Be fully aligned to our core values: - Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don't know they have.
- Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
- Take Action - Be the first. Don't wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
- Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. WHAT WE OFFER - Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.
- Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
- Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won't stand alone.
- Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.
- Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
- An open organisation. Titles don't define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone's work is seen and valued. Our Commitment to Inclusion At Syniti, we're committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we're dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we're here to support you.

title: Manager, Corporate Development - M&A Origination & Deal Sourcing
description: Gemini Group (csigemini.Com) is part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), a global acquirer, builder, and manager of vertical market software businesses. Gemini partners with high-quality software companies, providing long-term operational support, capital, and strategic guidance to help them grow sustainably. Our portfolio spans multiple vertical markets and operates through decentralized business units that are deeply embedded in their respective industries. Learn more here: csigemini.Com The Role The Manager, Corporate Development will play a critical role in identifying, building, and nurturing strategic relationships that lead to new acquisition opportunities for Gemini Group. In this role, you will engage with software company leaders. Your success will be measured by your ability to cultivate meaningful, trust-based relationships that ultimately result in Gemini acquiring high-quality software businesses. Relationship-building in this role is a long-term endeavor - often taking multiple years from first contact to acquisition. Success requires persistence, strategic thinking, disciplined pipeline management, high-quality market research, and a consistent ability to add value across many conversations. As Gemini continues to expand its presence globally, this Brazil based role will also play a foundational part in helping scale Gemini’s M&A capability in the LATAM market. Over time, the Manager, Corporate Development will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a localized M&A function - including shaping best practices and helping establish Gemini as a preferred partner for LATAM software entrepreneurs. This is a unique chance to be a builder of Gemini’s deal-sourcing footprint in Brazil while advancing your own leadership trajectory within the organization. Key Outcomes Develop, manage, and expand an M&A pipeline using Salesforce CRM, including market mapping within assigned software verticals. Meet and exceed weekly and quarterly sourcing and relationship-building KPIs. Work both independently and in collaboration with Gemini’s M&A leadership to efficiently evaluate potential acquisition opportunities. Ensure accurate categorization and allocation of leads within relevant portfolio verticals. Effectively screen and qualify opportunities at the top of the acquisition funnel to support Portfolio Managers and operating teams. Support the long-term build-out of Gemini’s LATAM/Brazil M&A presence by contributing to sourcing processes, knowledge sharing, and future team development. Engage directly with founders, CEOs, and controlling shareholders, conducting high-quality M&A conversations to understand ownership dynamics, M&A insights, motivations, business insights and timing of a future, potential deal. Qualify opportunities through initial commercial, operational, and financial assessment, filtering deals before internal escalation. Coordinate internally with global teams (Perseus / CSI) to align on pipeline prioritization and strategic fit. Maintain structured tracking of interactions and insights (CRM-driven), ensuring continuity and depth of relationship over time. Relevant Experience & Competencies At least three years of experience in M&A business development, with proven involvement in various aspects of M&A such as mandate origination (including private equity), initial contact with key decision-makers, deal negotiation, or client-facing roles in M&A or finance within the software or technology sector. Experience in outbound deal origination planning. Previous exposure on relationship-building meetings (virtual or in-person) with company owners to explore strategic M&A opportunities. Demonstrated interest in building a long-term career in software investing, M&A, or corporate development. Track record of high performance in business development, entrepreneurship, or other competitive environments. Strong executive presence with the ability to confidently engage senior leaders, including CEOs, investors, and advisors. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working autonomously. Self-motivated, proactive, and results-driven with a strong sense of urgency. Other Requirements Willingness to travel occasionally within Brazil and broader LATAM as well as internationally to Canada, the U.S., and Portugal. Professional working proficiency in both English and Portuguese is required. Professional working proficiency in Spanish is a bonus.

title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all. Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo. Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners. Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery. Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position. Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia Submission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Engineer Manager
description: ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data. Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. THE ROLE The Manager I of Engineering plays a key leadership role, directly managing a small team of software engineers. This role is responsible for ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software projects, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture, and supporting the professional growth of engineers. In addition to leading day-to-day execution, this manager contributes to tactical decision-making, participates in architectural discussions, and ensures engineering efforts are aligned with project goals. They collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver solutions that support Syniti’s broader mission. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Manage and support a team of software engineers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope. - Provide coaching, mentorship, and regular performance feedback to support individual growth. - Guide the team in applying engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and secure development. - Participate in architectural and technical design discussions, ensuring sound engineering decisions. - Collaborate closely with product and cross-functional teams to align priorities and deliver value. - Help shape a positive and inclusive team culture that fosters engagement, learning, and innovation. - Identify and address delivery risks, blockers, or process gaps within the team’s scope. - Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new engineers, and support team scaling efforts. WHAT IT TAKES - Proven experience as a team lead or first-line engineering manager in a software development environment. - Strong technical foundation in modern software development (e.G., C#, Go, React, TypeScript, AWS). - Familiarity with agile development methodologies, DevOps practices, and software delivery processes. - Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders. - Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and support the growth of engineering team members. - Experience participating in technical design, architecture reviews, and secure development practices. - Comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed, and cross-functional environment. Be fully aligned to our core values: - Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. - Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. - Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. - Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. WHAT WE OFFER - Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style. - Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. - Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. - Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all. - Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. - An open organisation. Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued. Our Commitment to Inclusion At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Visual & Brand Experience Designer
description: Visual & Brand Experience Designer About the Role We are seeking an experienced Visual & Brand Experience Designer to support a large-scale digital product initiative focused on modernizing the user experience of a leading marketplace platform. This role will play a key part in reimagining how customers navigate and interact with a multi-brand digital ecosystem. You will lead the Visual Makeover & Usability workstream while also helping shape a multi-brand gallery experience that brings together multiple brands within a single marketplace environment. The ideal candidate is a highly creative product designer who can quickly move from research and benchmarking into compelling visual concepts that inspire stakeholders and guide product direction. This is a fast-paced consulting environment with short delivery cycles, so comfort working in ambiguous environments and presenting bold ideas to senior stakeholders is essential. What You’ll Do Design and lead the visual direction for key product workstreams focused on improving usability and modernizing the marketplace interface. Conduct benchmarking of leading global marketplace platforms to inform design strategy and identify best-in-class user experience patterns. Develop high-fidelity visual concepts and exploratory prototypes that communicate new interface directions and inspire product leadership. Design and prototype a multi-brand navigation and discovery experience that enables users to seamlessly browse across brands within a unified marketplace. Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to translate design ideas into clear product directions. Present design concepts and rationale to senior stakeholders, helping guide decision-making around product experience and visual identity. Work within a fast-moving consulting team delivering iterative design outputs across short delivery cycles. Required Qualifications 5+ years of experience in product design, visual design, or UI design Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality interface design and visual storytelling Deep understanding of e-commerce and marketplace design patterns Experience analyzing and benchmarking international digital products Ability to produce high-fidelity concepts and exploratory prototypes that communicate bold design ideas Comfort presenting conceptual work to senior leadership and stakeholders Fluency in Portuguese (required working language) Ability to thrive in fast-paced consulting environments with rapid iteration cycles Preferred Qualifications Experience designing multi-brand digital ecosystems or marketplaces Familiarity with Asian marketplace and super-app UX paradigms such as those seen in Alibaba, Shopee, or Pinduoduo Background working with retail, consumer products, or marketplace platforms Previous experience in agency or consulting environments with fast delivery timelines If you’re a designer who enjoys pushing visual boundaries, exploring global product patterns, and shaping the experience of large-scale digital platforms, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a high-visibility product initiative.

title: Business Intelligence Developer (Remote)
description: A Brunel está apoiando uma consultoria de dados na busca por um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) de BI Pleno para atuar na construção e evolução de soluções analíticas, com forte ênfase em engenharia de dados. A atuação envolve contato frequente com interlocutores internacionais, por isso o inglês é essencial para o dia a dia (reuniões, alinhamentos e documentação). O dia a dia inclui desde a modelagem e transformação de dados até a entrega de dashboards e relatórios que suportem a tomada de decisão. A pessoa ideal combina domínio técnico em ferramentas de BI com sólida experiência em SQL e scripting para manipulação de dados em escala. Responsabilidades Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e soluções analíticas em Power BI ou Qlik (Sense/SaaS). Escrever e otimizar queries complexas em SQL para extração, transformação e carga de dados (ETL/ELT). Modelar dados dimensionais e relacionais, garantindo performance e escalabilidade das soluções. Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados utilizando scripts em SQL, Python ou outras linguagens pertinentes. Conectar e integrar múltiplas fontes de dados (bancos relacionais, APIs, arquivos flat, data lakes). Documentar processos, modelos de dados e regras de negócio de forma clara e acessível. Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (produto, engenharia, negócios) para traduzir necessidades em soluções de dados. Participar de code reviews e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de dados. Requisitos Experiência consolidada (3+ anos) com desenvolvimento de BI e/ou engenharia de dados. Domínio avançado de SQL (CTEs, window functions, otimização de queries, stored procedures). Experiência prática com Power BI (DAX, Power Query/M) e/ou Qlik (script de carga, set analysis). Conhecimento em modelagem de dados (star schema, snowflake, Data Vault). Experiência com pelo menos um banco de dados relacional (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle ou similar). Familiaridade com conceitos e ferramentas de ETL/ELT. Inglês avançado ou fluente, uso diário em reuniões e comunicação com times internacionais. Diferenciais Experiência com Python para manipulação e automação de dados. Vivência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (especialmente Snowflake). Conhecimento em ferramentas de orquestração (Airflow, dbt, Azure Data Factory, SSIS). Experiência com versionamento de código (Git). Familiaridade com práticas de DataOps e CI/CD aplicadas a dados. O que oferecemos Trabalho 100% remoto. Contratação PJ com remuneração competitiva. Flexibilidade de horário. Ambiente colaborativo e orientado a dados. Programa de capacitação continuada. Oportunidade de crescimento e atuação em projetos internacionais e desafiadores.

title: Data Operations Analyst
description: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence. We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery. What It’s Like to Work at YipitData: YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData: Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. About The Role: The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs. Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale. As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will: Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics. Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs. Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time. Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale. Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows. Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy. Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances. Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability. Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data. You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have… 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality. Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments. Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on. The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data. High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis. Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability. Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders. Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher). Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required): Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms. Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows. Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus. What We Offer: Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Personal laptop Health and wellness package Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Head Of Artificial Intelligence
description:
A Payfy é uma fintech B2B que está redefinindo como empresas operam financeiramente no Brasil. Estamos construindo a próxima geração de software financeiro — com forte uso de IA aplicada a problemas reais, complexos e críticos. Buscamos alguém para liderar essa evolução do ponto de vista técnico. O desafio Você será responsável por desenhar e liderar a construção de sistemas de decisão baseados em IA aplicados ao contexto financeiro. Isso inclui desde interpretação de dados não estruturados até automação de fluxos críticos com alto nível de confiabilidade. Essa não é uma vaga para trabalhar com IA. É uma vaga para construir sistemas que tomam decisões reais em produção. Responsabilidades Definir a arquitetura de sistemas baseados em IA (LLMs + lógica determinística) Construir pipelines de processamento de dados (estruturados e não estruturados) Desenvolver mecanismos de decisão automatizada com controle de risco Projetar sistemas robustos, com: fallback validação auditabilidade Trabalhar próximo do time de engenharia para garantir escalabilidade e performance Definir métricas e melhorar continuamente: precisão custo confiabilidade O que buscamos Experiência real colocando sistemas de IA em produção (não apenas protótipos) Forte capacidade de system design Experiência com: LLMs e/ou modelos de NLP pipelines de dados sistemas backend (APIs, filas, processamento assíncrono) Capacidade de tomar decisões pragmáticas (quando usar AI vs quando não usar) Mentalidade de produto (impacto >
perfeição) Diferenciais Experiência com dados financeiros ou sistemas críticos Já construiu sistemas com alto requisito de confiabilidade Experiência com avaliação e melhoria contínua de modelos Consegue explicar trade-offs técnicos de forma clara O que não buscamos Perfis focados apenas em prompt engineering Experiência apenas acadêmica ou experimental Falta de experiência com sistemas em produção Remuneração Contrato PJ Faixa: R$ 35k – R$ 45k/mês Processo Conversa inicial Entrevista técnica Case prático

fluent in Spanish to serve clients throughout LATAM;

Our people, Team HBX Group, are the beating heart of the company who we encourage to ‘move fast, dream big and make the difference’ every day. In fact, we believe that it is tech + data + people that truly sets us apart in the market, alongside our ‘global approach, local touch’ mentality. We’re headquartered in Palma, Mallorca and employ around 3,500 people worldwide. We are seeking a Global Contact Center Executive to join our dynamic Contact Center team. In this role, you will support our clients and suppliers, contributing to one of our core missions: delivering unique holiday experiences to our customers. This opportunity is open to candidates currently residing in Jundiaí. Role Overview The primary responsibility of this role is to assist clients—including tour operators, travel agencies, and end customers—with their inquiries, liaise with suppliers, and manage bookings in alignment with the standards and procedures of the Operations Department. The goal is to address client needs efficiently and effectively. Key Responsibilities Engage with callers in a professional and enthusiastic manner, representing HBX Group with excellence. Provide accurate and helpful information in response to client inquiries. Document all call activity clearly and accurately in the Back Office system. Respond promptly and precisely to online and email requests. Monitor and manage bookings, including reservations, special requests, amendments, and cancellations. Escalate issues appropriately, following Contact Center protocols. Maintain high standards of service quality and professionalism. Meet established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Adhere to all company policies and procedures. Follow assigned schedules and adapt to changes based on call volume. Required Skills and Qualifications Strong customer service orientation and active listening skills. Proficiency in English (spoken and written). Excellent verbal and written communication, with attention to grammar and clarity. Problem-solving mindset with persistence in resolving issues accurately and efficiently. Ability to follow detailed instructions independently. High attention to detail and adaptability. Consistent focus and enthusiasm throughout the work shift. If you are passionate about customer service, communication, and creative problem-solving, we encourage you to apply today! Note: Only candidates currently living in Jundiaí will be considered for this position in the Hybrid Model. At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference

- Strong communication skills, with at least an intermediate level of English.
- Experience working in distributed, cross functional teams. NICE TO HAVE - Kubernetes or EKS.
- Algolia.
- Shopify.

title: Back-End Technical Lead
description: At OSF Digital, we are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Back-End Technical Lead to drive the design, development, and optimization of scalable server-side solutions. Responsibilities: Lead and mentor a team of back-end developers, providing technical guidance and performance support. Design and implement robust, scalable, and high-performance back-end architectures. Oversee server-side logic, database design and maintenance, ensuring responsiveness to front-end requests. Ensure code quality, consistency, and maintainability through code reviews and best practices. Collaborate with Project Managers, Front-End Developers, DevOps, and other stakeholders to achieve project objectives. Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize applications for performance and scalability. Contribute to technical documentation, including architecture and design specifications. Act as the primary technical point of contact for back-end development topics. Stay up to date with emerging back-end technologies and assess their applicability to ongoing and future projects. Requirements: Proven experience as a Back-End Developer with a strong track record of successful project delivery. Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring development teams. Strong knowledge of back-end programming languages such as Java, Python, Ruby, or .NET. Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases and web server technologies. Solid understanding of RESTful APIs and microservices architecture. Proficiency with version control tools such as Git. Strong understanding of server-side logic, scalability, and performance optimization. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred. Fluency in English is required. Benefits: Discover OSF’s benefits and programs!

You will own the AI Tools and Hyper-Personalization workstreams, exploring how generative AI, advanced data models, and intelligent systems can transform how customers discover products, interact with sellers, and navigate digital retail environments. You will translate emerging technologies into compelling user experiences through prototypes, concept designs, and future-state product visions. Design innovative features powered by generative AI and machine learning, such as contextual search, personalized product detail pages, AI-generated retail media, and intelligent seller tools. Explore how data and personalization models can create dynamic, hyper-personalized user experiences throughout the shopping lifecycle. Develop concept prototypes and design explorations that communicate future product possibilities and inspire product leadership. Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and data teams to translate AI capabilities into meaningful user experiences. Present forward-looking concepts and design narratives to stakeholders, helping shape the long-term product vision. Operate within a fast-paced consulting environment with short delivery cycles and evolving requirements. Required Qualifications 5+ years of experience in product design or UX design, with exposure to emerging technologies or innovation-focused work Experience designing AI-powered or data-driven product experiences Strong conceptual thinking and ability to design future-state product concepts Ability to communicate complex ideas through prototypes, visual concepts, and design storytelling Understanding of personalization systems, recommendation engines, or conversational AI patterns Comfort working in ambiguous, early-stage product environments Fluency in Portuguese (required working language) Ability to work effectively in fast-paced consulting environments Preferred Qualifications Experience designing GenAI-powered features, including conversational interfaces, AI search, content generation, or recommendation systems Familiarity with retail media platforms, seller tools, or marketplace ecosystems Experience designing for conversational commerce platforms such as messaging-based shopping experiences Exposure to or interest in the Brazilian or Latin American technology ecosystem This role is ideal for a designer who enjoys exploring the intersection of AI, commerce, and product innovation. If you’re excited about shaping intelligent, personalized digital experiences and pushing the boundaries of what modern e-commerce can become, we’d love to connect.

Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!Analista de BIEstamos em busca de um(a) Analista de BI Sênior para atuar com foco na construção de dashboards em Power BI e, principalmente, na tradução das necessidades das áreas de negócio em indicadores estratégicos. A missão é transformar dados em informações acessíveis, confiáveis e de fácil compreensão, apoiando a tomada de decisão e contribuindo para a evolução da área de dados.Responsabilidades:Levantar requisitos junto às áreas de negócio, atuando de forma consultiva na definição de indicadores e soluções analíticas. Traduzir demandas em análises claras e relevantes para o negócio. Construir e manter dashboards em Power BI com foco em usabilidade e clareza das informações. Modelar e tratar dados garantindo consistência e confiabilidade. Automatizar processos de coleta, transformação e disponibilização de dados. Atuar na integração de dados entre diferentes sistemas. Apoiar na definição e evolução de métricas estratégicas. Trabalhar em parceria com diferentes áreas internas, garantindo alinhamento e qualidade das informações. Contribuir com a evolução das soluções de BI, apoiando iniciativas de modernização do ambiente de dados.Requisitos:Experiência sólida com Power BI (modelagem, DAX e construção de dashboards). Domínio de SQL para manipulação e análise de dados. Vivência na tradução de necessidades de negócio em indicadores e análises. Experiência com tratamento e integração de dados (ETL ou similar). Boa comunicação com áreas não técnicas.Diferenciais: Conhecimento em Python para análise e automação de dados. Experiência com integrações sistêmicas (APIs). Vivência com ambientes de dados em evolução, como Microsoft Fabric. Noções de modelagem e arquitetura de dados. Experiência com indicadores financeiros, controladoria, vendas ou RH. title: English Teacher
description: Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you! Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone. If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week. What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire? You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts. If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out. When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that! In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire: Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements: Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are: Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Consultor(A) Sap Pm - Pleno
description:
Make this the place where you grow! Como NTT DATA Business Solutions, somos mais do que apenas uma empresa. Elaborar especificações funcionais, cenários de testes e documentação técnica/funcional;

Realizar suporte às áreas internas, garantindo estabilidade e evolução dos processos;

Processos do módulo PM;
Configuração e parametrização;

title: Business Intelligence Developer (Remote)
description: A Brunel está apoiando uma consultoria de dados na busca por um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) de BI Pleno para atuar na construção e evolução de soluções analíticas, com forte ênfase em engenharia de dados. A atuação envolve contato frequente com interlocutores internacionais, por isso o inglês é essencial para o dia a dia (reuniões, alinhamentos e documentação). O dia a dia inclui desde a modelagem e transformação de dados até a entrega de dashboards e relatórios que suportem a tomada de decisão. A pessoa ideal combina domínio técnico em ferramentas de BI com sólida experiência em SQL e scripting para manipulação de dados em escala. Responsabilidades Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e soluções analíticas em Power BI ou Qlik (Sense/SaaS). Escrever e otimizar queries complexas em SQL para extração, transformação e carga de dados (ETL/ELT). Modelar dados dimensionais e relacionais, garantindo performance e escalabilidade das soluções. Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados utilizando scripts em SQL, Python ou outras linguagens pertinentes. Conectar e integrar múltiplas fontes de dados (bancos relacionais, APIs, arquivos flat, data lakes). Documentar processos, modelos de dados e regras de negócio de forma clara e acessível. Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (produto, engenharia, negócios) para traduzir necessidades em soluções de dados. Participar de code reviews e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de dados. Requisitos Experiência consolidada (3+ anos) com desenvolvimento de BI e/ou engenharia de dados. Domínio avançado de SQL (CTEs, window functions, otimização de queries, stored procedures). Experiência prática com Power BI (DAX, Power Query/M) e/ou Qlik (script de carga, set analysis). Conhecimento em modelagem de dados (star schema, snowflake, Data Vault). Experiência com pelo menos um banco de dados relacional (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle ou similar). Familiaridade com conceitos e ferramentas de ETL/ELT. Inglês avançado ou fluente, uso diário em reuniões e comunicação com times internacionais. Diferenciais Experiência com Python para manipulação e automação de dados. Vivência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (especialmente Snowflake). Conhecimento em ferramentas de orquestração (Airflow, dbt, Azure Data Factory, SSIS). Experiência com versionamento de código (Git). Familiaridade com práticas de DataOps e CI/CD aplicadas a dados. O que oferecemos Trabalho 100% remoto. Contratação PJ com remuneração competitiva. Flexibilidade de horário. Ambiente colaborativo e orientado a dados. Programa de capacitação continuada. Oportunidade de crescimento e atuação em projetos internacionais e desafiadores.

title: Manager, Corporate Development - M&A Origination & Deal Sourcing
description: Gemini Group (csigemini.Com) is part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), a global acquirer, builder, and manager of vertical market software businesses. Gemini partners with high-quality software companies, providing long-term operational support, capital, and strategic guidance to help them grow sustainably. Our portfolio spans multiple vertical markets and operates through decentralized business units that are deeply embedded in their respective industries. Learn more here: csigemini.Com The Role The Manager, Corporate Development will play a critical role in identifying, building, and nurturing strategic relationships that lead to new acquisition opportunities for Gemini Group. In this role, you will engage with software company leaders. Your success will be measured by your ability to cultivate meaningful, trust-based relationships that ultimately result in Gemini acquiring high-quality software businesses. Relationship-building in this role is a long-term endeavor - often taking multiple years from first contact to acquisition. Success requires persistence, strategic thinking, disciplined pipeline management, high-quality market research, and a consistent ability to add value across many conversations. As Gemini continues to expand its presence globally, this Brazil based role will also play a foundational part in helping scale Gemini's M&A capability in the LATAM market. Over time, the Manager, Corporate Development will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a localized M&A function - including shaping best practices and helping establish Gemini as a preferred partner for LATAM software entrepreneurs. This is a unique chance to be a builder of Gemini's deal-sourcing footprint in Brazil while advancing your own leadership trajectory within the organization. Key Outcomes Develop, manage, and expand an M&A pipeline using Salesforce CRM, including market mapping within assigned software verticals. Meet and exceed weekly and quarterly sourcing and relationship-building KPIs. Work both independently and in collaboration with Gemini's M&A leadership to efficiently evaluate potential acquisition opportunities. Ensure accurate categorization and allocation of leads within relevant portfolio verticals. Effectively screen and qualify opportunities at the top of the acquisition funnel to support Portfolio Managers and operating teams. Support the long-term build-out of Gemini's LATAM/Brazil M&A presence by contributing to sourcing processes, knowledge sharing, and future team development. Engage directly with founders, CEOs, and controlling shareholders, conducting high-quality M&A conversations to understand ownership dynamics, M&A insights, motivations, business insights and timing of a future, potential deal. Qualify opportunities through initial commercial, operational, and financial assessment, filtering deals before internal escalation. Coordinate internally with global teams (Perseus / CSI) to align on pipeline prioritization and strategic fit. Maintain structured tracking of interactions and insights (CRM-driven), ensuring continuity and depth of relationship over time. Relevant Experience & Competencies At least three years of experience in M&A business development, with proven involvement in various aspects of M&A such as mandate origination (including private equity), initial contact with key decision-makers, deal negotiation, or client-facing roles in M&A or finance within the software or technology sector. Experience in outbound deal origination planning. Previous exposure on relationship-building meetings (virtual or in-person) with company owners to explore strategic M&A opportunities. Demonstrated interest in building a long-term career in software investing, M&A, or corporate development. Track record of high performance in business development, entrepreneurship, or other competitive environments. Strong executive presence with the ability to confidently engage senior leaders, including CEOs, investors, and advisors. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working autonomously. Self-motivated, proactive, and results-driven with a strong sense of urgency. Other Requirements Willingness to travel occasionally within Brazil and broader LATAM as well as internationally to Canada, the U.S., and Portugal. Professional working proficiency in both English and Portuguese is required. Professional working proficiency in Spanish is a bonus.

title: Data Entry & Research Coordinator (English Required)
description: OverviewFull Spectrum Search Group is a national healthcare recruiting firm focused on post-acute and senior care leadership, including skilled nursing, senior living, home health, and hospice.We are hiring a Data Entry & Research Coordinator to support our recruiting team by maintaining and updating candidate information in our internal database.This role is ideal for detail-oriented, organized professionals early in their careers who are comfortable working with large amounts of information and ensuring data is accurate, complete, and up to date.The RoleThis is a production-focused position responsible for entering, updating, and correcting candidate data. Your work ensures our recruiting team has clean, reliable information to operate efficiently. This is not a technical or IT role. The focus is on accuracy, organization, and consistency.What You Will DoData Entry and UpdatesEnter and update candidate information in internal systemsReview records for missing, incorrect, or outdated informationMake corrections to ensure data is accurate and completeResearch and Data CollectionUse LinkedIn, Google, and other tools to find and verify candidate informationAdd relevant details such as contact information, job titles, and company dataData Quality and OrganizationMaintain clean and well-structured recordsEnsure all data is ready for recruiter use with minimal revisionsTrack progress and stay organized across multiple assignmentsTeam SupportWork closely with recruiters to support ongoing searchesFollow instructions and adjust priorities as neededCommunicate clearly regarding progress or questionsRequirementsAdvanced English (required) – written and reading comprehensionStrong attention to detail and accuracyHigh level of organization and ability to follow processesAbility to handle repetitive tasks with consistency and focusComfortable working with spreadsheets (Google Sheets or Excel)Ability to manage time and meet deadlinesPreferred BackgroundExperience in data entry, administrative support, research, or similar rolesFamiliarity with LinkedIn or online research tools is a plusCollege degree preferred but not requiredWhat We Look ForYou are detail-oriented and catch mistakes easilyYou are reliable and follow through on tasksYou are comfortable doing repetitive, process-driven workYou take pride in keeping information clean and organizedCompensation and LogisticsCompetitive compensation based on experienceFull-time remote positionUS Central Time scheduleGrowth opportunities based on performanceThis is a great opportunity for someone looking to build experience in a structured, professional environment while developing strong organizational and data management skills.

title: Language Specialist
description: Job Title: Language Specialist – AI Training (Freelancer) Location: Brazil (Remote – Candidates must be based in Brazil) About the Role: As a Language Specialist, you will play a vital role in training and enhancing Large Language Models (LLMs). This involves evaluating prompts, rating AI-generated outputs, and creating high-quality content to improve the accuracy, fluency, and cultural relevance of AI systems used by global technology leaders. Key Responsibilities: Evaluate AI-generated prompts and responses for linguistic accuracy, coherence, and contextual relevance. Provide structured ratings and feedback on AI outputs, highlighting errors, biases, or inconsistencies. Develop, edit, and curate high-quality content for training datasets across diverse domains. Collaborate with linguists, annotators, and AI researchers to refine model performance. Ensure cultural and linguistic nuances are accurately represented. Follow established guidelines while also suggesting improvements for evaluation frameworks. Qualifications: Strong written and spoken command of the target language, with excellent grammar and stylistic skills. Prior experience in content writing, editing, or evaluation preferred. Analytical mindset with keen attention to detail. Interest in AI, NLP, or LLMs will be an advantage.
