description: Product Owner - Sênior A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui. Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala. Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos. Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente? Qual será o seu papel? No seu dia a dia, você gerenciará o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias. Atuará como principal interlocutor entre as áreas de negócio (operações, comercial, regulatório, supply chain) e os times de desenvolvimento, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos claros e viáveis. Além disso, acompanhará métricas de desempenho do produto (KPIs de negócio e de uso), proporá evoluções baseadas em dados e feedback dos usuários, e garantirá que as soluções desenvolvidas estejam em conformidade com as normas de segurança e regulação do setor de gás. Como será seu dia a dia? Gerenciar o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias. Atuar como principal interlocutor(a) entre áreas de negócio (operações, comercial, regulatório e supply chain) e os times de desenvolvimento, traduzindo necessidades em requisitos técnicos claros e viáveis. Liderar cerimônias ágeis e garantir a entrega contínua de valor para o produto. Promover melhorias incrementais nos processos de distribuição de gás. Acompanhar métricas de desempenho (KPIs de negócio e de uso), analisando dados para direcionar evoluções do produto. Propor melhorias com base em dados e feedbacks dos usuários. Garantir que as soluções estejam em conformidade com normas de segurança e regulação do setor. Para esta vaga, é essencial: Visão holística e estratégica, com capacidade de compreender o negócio de distribuição de gás de ponta a ponta, conectando iniciativas de tecnologia às metas do negócio. Perfil de liderança com forte viés de execução, sendo “mão na massa”, orientado(a) a resultados e capaz de remover impedimentos para garantir entregas com qualidade e agilidade. Excelente comunicação e habilidade de transitar entre áreas, atuando como ponte entre negócio e tecnologia. Sólido conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) e práticas de gestão de produto (roadmaps, OKRs, MVPs). Experiência na liderança de squads multidisciplinares e atuação em ciclos de discovery e delivery. Formação superior em Administração, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas. Você pode se destacar se: Possuir pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Negócios, Energia ou Transformação Digital. Tiver certificações em Product Ownership (CSPO, PSPO) e metodologias ágeis (CSM, SAFe). Tiver familiaridade com o setor de gás e energia, incluindo regulação da ANP e processos como medição, faturamento, logística e segurança operacional. Demonstrar forte visão sistêmica e pensamento crítico. Apresentar habilidade de negociação e influência. Ser resiliente e adaptável em ambientes de alta complexidade. Ter perfil colaborativo e facilitador. Demonstrar orientação a resultados e senso de urgência. Possuir experiência em contextos dinâmicos. Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

description:
Credit Risk Analyst — Consumer Lending | Digital Origination300 Software · Remote (Brazil) · Full-time | PJBefore you read further: this is NOT an FP&A, Treasury, Controller, corporate credit, or FIDC role. If your background is primarily in those areas, this position is a different discipline and will likely not be a good fit.Our US fintech client — an online consumer lender — is looking for a Credit Risk Analyst who owns the front end of the credit funnel: designing risk tiers, sequencing underwriting decisions, managing approval/decline trade-offs, and building the logic that determines who gets credit and at what terms. If you have hands-on experience with risk tiers, underwriting decision paths, dynamic acquisition pricing, or rescue lane strategies at an online lender, BNPL provider, or fintech — this role is built for youIf you have hands-on experience with risk tiers, underwriting decision paths, dynamic acquisition pricing, or rescue lane strategies at an online lender, BNPL provider, or fintech — this role is built for you.What You'll DoOwn and iterate credit acquisition policies inside an automated decisioning engineBuild and validate scorecards;
monitor performance through vintage analysis and population stabilitySegment applicants by acquisition channel, product, and risk tier — and price accordinglyIdentify emerging fraud patterns and respond with targeted policy changesWork cross-functionally with US product and marketing teams to balance growth and riskWrite SQL to investigate, model, and monitor — no waiting on a data teamRequirements (Non Negotiable)- 3+ years of experience in online consumer lending, BNPL, or a tangential fintech/e-commerce credit environment- Hands-on acquisition/top-of-funnel risk experience: risk tier assessment, underwriting sequencing, or dynamic acquisition pricing- Fluent English — interviews, daily standups, and all written communication are in English- SQL proficiency — comfortable writing queries independently to analyze credit performance data- Ability to work US Central Time hours (approx. 9am–6pm CT / 11am–8pm Brasília)Nice to Have- Experience with rescue lane management or near-miss recovery programs- Background in fraud risk within the acquisition funnel- Exposure to multi-path underwriting logic or decision engine configuration- Portfolio monitoring and credit loss forecasting (post-acquisition)- Experience at an e-commerce, marketplace lending, or embedded finance companyWhat We Offer- PJ/contractor arrangement — compensation aligned with fintech market rates- 100% remote — work from anywhere in Brazil- US Central Time schedule — structured workday, no late nights- Direct exposure to a fast-growing US online lending operationQuick Self-ScreenIn your last role: were the majority of credit decisions made automatically, within seconds, for individual consumers (not companies)? title: Technical Product Owner
description: ABOUT USSyniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world's largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.Syniti's Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.Operating globally across industries, Syniti's award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.Syniti's cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.THE ROLEWe are seeking a highly technical and execution‐driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the "engine room" of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‐level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‐native, AI‐driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the "Golden Record" through seamless end‐to‐end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.What You'll DoProduct Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‐class workflows within SKP.Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‐functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define "What Good Looks Like." Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‐world user behavior.Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.WHAT IT TAKESThe Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance "plumbing." Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‐zone teams.The Academic: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.Key SkillsVisionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‐matching or data‐cleansing logic.Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‐moving environment.Be fully aligned with our core values:Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don't know they have.Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.Take Action - Be the first. Don't wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.WHAT WE OFFERTrust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won't stand alone.Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone's work is seen, and ideas are valued.OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSIONAt Syniti, we're committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we're dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we're here to support you.

title: Supply Chain Analyst
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work. Overview of the role: We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities. Key responsibilities: - Determine supply needs for products and services and research potential suppliers.
- Act as a link and communicate pricing and performance needs to vendors and suppliers.
- Participate in negotiations of favorable procurement contracts and prices with selected vendors and suppliers.
- Select the most suitable suppliers in terms of reliability, product quality, and cost-efficiency.
- Maintain and update a list of suppliers and their qualifications, delivery times, and potential future development.
- Prepare cost-benefit analysis reports for review by managers. Requirements: - 2+ years of experience in a supply management role or related position.
- Knowledge of SAP or SAP B1.
- Degree in supply chain management, logistics, business management, or related fields.
- Experience in managing inventory.
- Proficiency in SQL analysis tools and mathematical analysis.
- Interpersonal skills and ability to build and improve trust.
- Advanced level of English. Benefits: - Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.
- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.
- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.
- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.
- Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.
- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.
- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.
- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement. If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Executive Headhunter
description: At BairesDev, we've been leading the way in technology projects for over 15 years. We deliver cutting-edge solutions to giants like Google and the most innovative startups in Silicon Valley.Our diverse 4,000+ team, composed of the world's Top 1% of tech talent, works remotely on roles that drive significant impact worldwide.When you apply for this position, you're taking the first step in a process that goes beyond the ordinary. We aim to align your passions and skills with our vacancies, setting you on a path to exceptional career development and success.Talent Acquisition Senior Auditor at BairesDevAs a Senior Auditor, you'll play a key role in ensuring the quality, consistency, and reliability of recruitment audits. You'll handle complex and high-impact cases, review and guide junior auditors, and help align evaluation criteria across the team. This role offers the chance to make a real impact by improving the quality of hiring processes, working on meaningful and complex cases, shaping audit standards, and helping both processes and people grow through clear feedback and continuous improvement.What You'll Do:- Execute complex, sensitive, and high-impact audits.- Supervise and review Junior Auditors' evaluations.- Lead calibration calls and standardize criteria across the audit team.What we are looking for:- 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance roles.- Proven experience auditing complex and high-impact roles, including senior profiles, closers, and specialized positions.- Hands-on experience supervising and calibrating Junior Auditors to ensure consistency and accuracy across evaluations.- Advanced proficiency in English.Nice to have:- Experience in Talent Acquisition.- Experience working with high-volume recruitment processes.- Experience in data analysis and SQL.How we do make your work (and your life) easier:- 100% remote work (from anywhere).- Excellent compensation in USD or your local currency if preferred- Hardware and software setup for you to work from home.- Flexible hours: create your own schedule.- Paid parental leaves, vacations, and national holidays.- Innovative and multicultural work environment: collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent.- Supportive environment with mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities.Apply now and become part of a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive!

title: Ai Data Annotation Specialist
description: Job Role : AI Data Annotation Specialist Location: Brazil Work Type: Freelance / Project-based About the Role We are looking for Freelance Data Annotation Specialists with strong English proficiency to support global AI and Large Language Model (LLM) projects. This is a project-based freelancing opportunity, ideal for individuals seeking flexible work while contributing to cutting-edge AI development. Key Responsibilities Annotate and review text-based data following detailed project guidelines Perform language-centric tasks such as classification, evaluation, and reasoning Maintain high accuracy, consistency, and quality standards Meet defined productivity benchmarks within project timelines Flag unclear or ambiguous data as per escalation guidelines Ensure confidentiality and compliance with data security requirements Required Skills & Qualifications Excellent English and Portuguese proficiency (written and spoken) Strong attention to detail and analytical skills Comfortable working independently in a remote/project-based setup Basic computer literacy and familiarity with online tools Prior experience in data annotation, content review, or similar roles is a plus Additional Information This is a freelancing role and does not include full-time employment benefits Background verification is mandatory prior to onboarding

title: Product Designer
description: At Avenue Code, we are passionate about transforming businesses through technology. We are a leading end-to-end development consultancy for digital transformation across various markets, growing sustainably since day one. We believe that great results are born from strong relationships. Our team combines technical expertise, collaboration, and a welcoming approach to work that makes all the difference.About The OpportunityWe are looking for a Product Designer to join a fast-paced, product-driven environment focused on building innovative digital experiences in the data and financial technology space.In this role, you will design end-to-end product experiences for a platform that redefines how users interact with and manage their data. You will work on complex, first-of-their-kind solutions, translating concepts such as data ownership, privacy, and monetization into intuitive, user-friendly interfaces for both consumers and businesses.Responsibilities- Own the end-to-end design process, from discovery and research to delivery and developer handoff.- Conduct user research, usability testing, and validation to inform design decisions.- Translate complex concepts into clear, intuitive, and accessible user experiences.- Collaborate closely with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to align vision and execution.- Create and iterate on wireframes, prototypes, and user flows based on feedback and data.- Contribute to and maintain a Design System across web and mobile platforms.- Ensure consistency, usability, and high-quality visual design across all touchpoints.- Support the creation of marketing and web assets aligned with brand guidelines.Required Qualifications- Strong experience in Product Design with a portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product work.- Proficiency in Figma for design, prototyping, and developer handoff.- Ability to simplify complex systems and concepts into intuitive user experiences.- Hands-on experience with user research, discovery, and validation methods.- Experience building and evolving Design Systems in collaboration with engineering teams.- Ability to work independently in high-ambiguity, fast-paced environments.- Strong collaboration skills and a user-centered mindset.- Experience using tools such as user journey mapping, flow diagrams, and prototyping techniques.- Understanding of different levels of design fidelity, from low-fidelity concepts to production-ready designs.- Advanced to Fluent level of English (mandatory).Nice To Have Skills- Experience with Webflow or Framer for marketing or institutional websites.- Background in AI, privacy, or data-related products.- Experience designing native mobile applications (iOS and Android).- Experience working on products in early-stage or product-market fit environments.Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

description:

- Experiência com OCI Data Integration ou ferramenta equivalente de orquestração e transformação de dados em Oracle Cloud.
- Conhecimento em Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW) e Oracle Object Storage.
- Experiência com integração de dados via APIs REST e múltiplas fontes de dados heterogêneas.
- Experiência com SQL avançado e modelagem de dados (dimensional e analítica).
- Vivência com arquiteturas modernas de Data Lake em cloud, incluindo padrões de camadas de dados (medallion ou equivalente).
- Vivência com ferramentas de ETL/ELT e integração de dados.
- Experiência com linguagens de programação voltadas a dados (Python ou similar). Diferenciais: - Experiência com Oracle Fusion Analytics Warehouse (FAW) — extração e entendimento do modelo de dados do Fusion.
- Vivência com Oracle Data Catalog para gestão de metadados e linhagem de dados.
- Experiência com Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) para integração de sistemas.
- Familiaridade com Power BI como camada de consumo dos dados estruturados. Modelo de Trabalho - Remoto - Contratação PJ Benefícios ATRA: - TotalPass - Reembolso 100% em certificações - Parcerias educacionais - Trilhas de capacitação e comunidades técnicas - Projetos desafiadores com tecnologias de ponta Sobre a ATRA Somos uma consultoria brasileira com +15 anos de mercado, especializada em Dados, Analytics, Engenharia, Governança e IA. title: Technical Product Owner
description: ABOUT USSyniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world's largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.Syniti's Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.Operating globally across industries, Syniti's award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.Syniti's cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.THE ROLEWe are seeking a highly technical and execution‐driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the "engine room" of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‐level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‐native, AI‐driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the "Golden Record" through seamless end‐to‐end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.What You'll DoProduct Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‐class workflows within SKP.Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‐functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define "What Good Looks Like." Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‐world user behavior.Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.WHAT IT TAKESThe Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.What You'll Gain:- Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:- 3-Statement Financial Modeling- Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis- Trading Comparables (Comps)- Precedent Transactions- Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques- Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies- Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:- Pitch Book Development- Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)- Financial Modeling- Sourcing & Due Diligence- Industry and Company Research- And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.- Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.Who We're Looking For:This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.How to Apply:Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Backend Team Lead
description: Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) Location: Brazil Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions. Position Overview As a Backend Team Lead, you will play a key role in leading the backend development team while contributing to the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions that support the company's mission and goals. You will guide and support the backend team while working closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes. Primary Responsibilities Team Leadership: Lead and support the backend engineering team, ensuring effective collaboration, task distribution, and delivery of high-quality software. Platform Development: Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel, ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability. Database Development: Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes. API Development and Integration: Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services. Security Compliance: Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA, by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols. Additional Responsibilities Mentor backend developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration. Support the team in resolving technical challenges and ensure consistent development standards across the team. Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform. Participate in an agile development environment, contributing to team coordination and iterative delivery processes, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software. Competencies / Requirements Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL. Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git. Experience: At least 6+ years of experience in backend development, with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Previous experience leading or mentoring developers is required. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable. Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions. Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders. Attention to Detail: A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform. Benefits Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements. Flexible work environment. Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead
description:
About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L Job Overview: An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers, and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end. Key Responsibilities: Team Leadership Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation. Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads. Technical Oversight Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading, Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues. Problem Design (Individual Contribution) Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain. Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions. Electrical Engineering Subdomains: You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus: Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation. Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization. RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design. Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design. Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting. Required Qualifications: Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline. At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation. At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role. Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows. Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments. Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs. Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.G., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar). Nice-to-Have: Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks. Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation. Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems. Evaluation Process: Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form. After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements. After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile. Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.Com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Sr Data & Analytics Engineer \&34;999885\&34;
description:
Quem Somos "A DEXIAN é uma consultoria global de origem Americana focada em talentos para complementar a equipe de tecnologia da informação de nossos clientes. Estamos presente em 10 países, com 45 escritórios ao redor do mundo. Por mais de 25 anos, a DEXIAN atende indústrias e clientes globais, em diversas áreas, com a missão de atrair e reter os maiores talentos do mundo. Hoje somos orgulhosamente reconhecidos como uma das maiores empresas de "staffing augmentation" dos Estados Unidos pela Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade. No Brasil, chegamos em 2007 e de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. O que esperar de nós É importante que você saiba que por trás de cada movimento DEXIAN existem cinco valores fundamentais: colaboração, respeito, justiça, comprometimento e engenhosidade. Colaboração, justiça e respeito não são apenas palavras;
comprometimento não é só um pensamento;
e engenhosidade vai além de aspiração. Essas qualidades nos definem em todos os níveis, todas as parcerias e na forma como trabalhamos todos os dias. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco? A DEXIAN do Brasil incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados. Nosso Cliente Essa vaga irá atender nosso cliente no segmento de engenharia de sistemas. O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho Our client is looking for a Data & Analytics Engineer with a passion for data and strong analytics capabilities to help grow our business. The Data & Analytics Engineer will support profitable and sustainable sales strategies with customers and help develop advanced sales reporting and analytics capabilities for scale. This person will champion our mission to be data-driven and will possess strong interpersonal skills, robust technical and data analysis capabilities, and a natural sense of curiosity that drives them to identify trends and promote opportunities. The position is sure to develop one's leadership, management, and analytics capabilities as well as provide an exciting career path. The role is highly visible with broad exposure to senior leaders across the business. Key Responsibilities · Leverage data tools to provide reporting and insights which will further develop company and retailer objectives. · Create and maintain customer scorecards inclusive of key metrics such as volume, share, distribution, weekly sales ranks, store performance, etc. · Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability. · Responsible for developing and running weekly and monthly brand reports to help partnership teams understand trends. · Ability to prioritize work and key projects based on the needs of the team and the business · Design, build, and maintain reliable data pipelines to move and transform data from disparate sources (Excel, ERP, CRM, operational systems) into the enterprise data warehouse (Snowflake). · Develop and manage data models (dimensional and semantic layers) that enable analysts and business users to access trusted, well-structured data for reporting. · Collaborate with analysts and business stakeholders to translate reporting/analytics needs into scalable data solutions while documenting definitions and lineage. · Ad-hoc requests/projects as needed. O que você precisa ter: · Advenced english is primordial, you'll work with an international team. · 5+ years of experience data engineering, ETL/ELT development, or analytics engineering · Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data engineering or related field, OR equivalent hands-on experience · Proficient in SQL (writing, optimizing and troubleshooting complex queries) · Understanding of database concepts such as database structures, query languages (SQL), and data warehousing principles. · Experience working with ETL and data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx, other). · Proven track record of building collaborative relationships across functional areas. · Self-starter with an ability to drive projects from initiation to completion. · Adept at prioritizing work and key projects based on the needs of the team and the business. Onde você vai trabalhar: Regime remoto, qualquer lugar do Brasil.

title: Analista De P&D - Golang/C++
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo? Então essa é a sua chance! Buscamos: Analista de P&D - Golang/C++ Resumo do Propósito da Função: Esta função oferece uma empolgante posição de desenvolvimento de software na equipe de Engenharia, uma organização multicultural com times baseados na Europa e na América do Sul, responsável por pesquisar e desenvolver soluções de hardware e software para sistemas de medição de audiência utilizados globalmente. Este profissional fará parte da equipe responsável pelos sistemas de correspondência de áudio desenvolvidos pelo IBOPE, que estão sendo implementados em diversos países. Esse sistema compara áudios coletados por dispositivos de medição dedicados com uma biblioteca de conteúdos de TV, utilizando a tecnologia proprietária de correspondência de áudio do IBOPE (técnica de fingerprinting). O IBOPE possui sistemas desenvolvidos tanto para ambientes on-premises quanto em nuvem, utilizando uma abordagem agnóstica de cloud. Sua arquitetura é composta por diversas tecnologias de ponta, como containers, Kubernetes, entre outras. Esta função envolve: Manutenção de tecnologias existentes baseadas em Linux para ambientes on-premises. Pesquisa, criação e desenvolvimento de aplicações — baseadas em charts do Kubernetes e/ou disponíveis na CNCF (Cloud Native Computing Foundation) — responsáveis por comunicação, busca otimizada em grandes volumes de dados, armazenamento de dados e mais, utilizando tecnologias e técnicas avançadas. Manutenção de pipelines. Melhoria do código por meio da adição de ferramentas para avaliação da qualidade do código. RESPONSABILIDADES: Manter tecnologias existentes implantadas em vários países. Implementar novas tecnologias para sistemas de medição de audiência com base em tecnologias existentes e novas. Pesquisar novas tecnologias para aprimorar o produto. Desenvolver novos serviços. Criar novos charts do Kubernetes. Garantir a comunicação dos containers Kubernetes dentro e fora dos clusters. Manter a tecnologia atual. REQUISITOS: Essencial: Superior completo ou cursando último ano na área de tecnologia. Experiência com Linux / bash scripting. Sólidos conhecimentos em C++ and/or Golang TDD – metodologia de testes Experiência com SQL database e NoSQL database. Inglês avançado para conversas técnicas e documentação. Desejável: Javascript Kubernetes AKS Terraform Monitoring systems Prometheus Stack Messaging (RabbitMQ) O que oferecemos? Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade: Vale Refeição e Alimentação Horário Flexível Modelo de trabalho remoto Assistência Médica e Odontológica Convênio Farmácia Participação nos Lucros e Resultados Previdência Privada Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos Convênio com empresas parceiras Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe;
Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais Programa de Mobilidade Interna: valorizamos talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua Se o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você! No IBOPE a diversidade faz parte do negócio, gerando inovação e resultados. Não fazemos distinção de raça, religião, nacionalidade, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência, gravidez, estado civil ou qualquer outra forma de discriminação.

title: Sap Basis Expert - Inglês Avançado
description: Make this the place where you grow! Como NTT DATA Business Solutions, somos mais do que apenas uma empresa. Somos uma equipe de pessoas apaixonadas que impulsionam a inovação – desde consultoria e implementação até serviços gerenciados e muito mais. Com a SAP no nosso núcleo e um poderoso ecossistema de parceiros como Microsoft e ServiceNow, continuamos aprimorando soluções e tecnologias baseadas em IA para que funcionem para as empresas – e para suas pessoas. Fazemos parte da NTT DATA, líder de US$ 30+ bilhões em serviços empresariais e tecnológicos, IA e infraestrutura digital, atendendo 75% da Fortune Global 100. Co-inovamos soluções com clientes e parceiros globalmente para impacto empresarial e social. Como um dos principais empregadores globais, a NTT DATA conta com especialistas em mais de 70 países. A NTT DATA faz parte do Grupo NTT. Buscamos um(a) SAP Basis Expert com sólida experiência em projetos complexos de upgrade, conversão e migração de ambientes SAP. Você atuará em um contexto global, liderando execuções técnicas críticas, garantindo estabilidade, performance e evolução de ambientes SAP, colaborando com times multiculturais e clientes internacionais. Principais Responsabilidades: Liderar tecnicamente projetos de upgrades, conversões, migrações e manutenções em ambientes SAP. Planejar e executar estratégias completas de evolução de sistemas: análise de impacto, roadmap técnico, cronogramas e execução em ambientes Dev/QA/Prod. Conduzir processos de system upgrade, system conversion, OS/DB migration, e HANA upgrades, assegurando conformidade com melhores práticas SAP. Realizar cutover planning, coordenação de mock runs e atividades críticas de produção. Diagnosticar incidentes complexos em ambientes SAP Basis, atuando na resolução de problemas e mitigação de riscos. Garantir documentação completa dos processos técnicos, lições aprendidas e recomendações de melhoria contínua. Colaborar com equipes funcionais, arquitetos e stakeholders globais para assegurar compatibilidade e readiness das soluções. Acompanhar o roadmap SAP, avaliando impactos e oportunidades de atualização para os ambientes dos clientes. Requisitos: 8+ anos de experiência comprovada em SAP Basis. Domínio em: SAP system upgrades (NetWeaver, EHP, SPS, Kernel) SAP S/4HANA conversions (pré-checks, simplification item, custom code remediation) System copies e client copies OS/DB migrations e Unicode conversions HANA database upgrades Proficiência com ferramentas: SUM, DMO, Maintenance Planner, SPAM/SAINT. Inglês avançado para comunicação com equipes e clientes internacionais. Experiência em ambientes globais ou operações Nearshore é um diferencial. Diferenciais: Certificações SAP Basis ou SAP HANA. Experiência com ambientes Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP). Vivência com projetos multiculturais. Regime de Contratação: Modelo de CLT Modalidade: 100% Home office Somos a maior empresa de consultoria SAP do mundo para empresas de médio porte. Torne-se um especialista trabalhando em grandes projetos. Com as parcerias SAP Platinum, Microsoft e AWS, impulsionamos a inovação e adotamos novas tecnologias. Com a nossa visão e ambição, entregamos desempenho de alta performance. *Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead
description:
About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world's leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L Job Overview: An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers, and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end. Key Responsibilities: Team Leadership Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation. Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads. Technical Oversight Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading, Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues. Problem Design (Individual Contribution) Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain. Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions. Electrical Engineering Subdomains: You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus: Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation. Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization. RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design. Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design. Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting. Required Qualifications: Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline. At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation. At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role. Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows. Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments. Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs. Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.G., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar). Nice-to-Have: Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks. Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation. Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems. Evaluation Process: Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form. After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‐onboarding requirements. After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile. Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.Com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead
description:
About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L Job Overview: An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers, and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end. Key Responsibilities: Team Leadership Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation. Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads. Technical Oversight Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading, Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues. Problem Design (Individual Contribution) Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain. Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions. Electrical Engineering Subdomains: You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus: Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation. Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization. RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design. Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design. Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting. Required Qualifications: Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline. At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation. At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role. Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows. Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments. Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs. Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.G., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar). Nice-to-Have: Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks. Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation. Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems. Evaluation Process: Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form. After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements. After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile. Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.Com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

Pesquisa, criação e desenvolvimento de aplicações — baseadas em charts do Kubernetes e/ou disponíveis na CNCF (Cloud Native Computing Foundation) — responsáveis por comunicação, busca otimizada em grandes volumes de dados, armazenamento de dados e mais, utilizando tecnologias e técnicas avançadas. Manutenção de pipelines. Melhoria do código por meio da adição de ferramentas para avaliação da qualidade do código. RESPONSABILIDADES: Manter tecnologias existentes implantadas em vários países. Implementar novas tecnologias para sistemas de medição de audiência com base em tecnologias existentes e novas. Pesquisar novas tecnologias para aprimorar o produto. Desenvolver novos serviços. Criar novos charts do Kubernetes. Garantir a comunicação dos containers Kubernetes dentro e fora dos clusters. Manter a tecnologia atual. REQUISITOS: Essencial: Superior completo ou cursando último ano na área de tecnologia. Experiência com Linux / bash scripting. Sólidos conhecimentos em C++ and/or Golang TDD – metodologia de testes Experiência com SQL database e NoSQL database. Inglês avançado para conversas técnicas e documentação. Desejável: Javascript Kubernetes AKS Terraform Monitoring systems Prometheus Stack Messaging (RabbitMQ) O que oferecemos? title: Data Operations Analyst
description: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence. We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery. What It’s Like to Work at YipitData: YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData: Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. About The Role: The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs. Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale. As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will: Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics. Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs. Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time. Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale. Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows. Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy. Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances. Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability. Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data. You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have… 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality. Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments. Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on. The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data. High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis. Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability. Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders. Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher). Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required): Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms. Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows. Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus. What We Offer: Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Personal laptop Health and wellness package Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Jde Cnc Consultant
description:
About Us: Redfaire is a growing, international technology company headquartered in Limerick, Ireland. Redfaire helps global organisations modernise their JD Edwards environments, migrate to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and unlock value through automation, analytics, and innovation. Innovation is at the heart of everything at Redfaire, we provide guidance and expertise to our customers in Oracle Cloud, Integrations, AI and Machine Learning. Headquartered in Limerick, Ireland, we also have offices in UK and USA and a direct presence in other international locations. As a founding partner of Redfaire International, a global network of top-tier JD Edwards consultancies, we’re able to deliver even broader, more impactful solutions to our clients worldwide. About the Role: We are currently recruiting a CNC Consultant to join our busy Technical Services Team. The CNC Consultant is responsible for the installation and configuration of JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, including environment setup, user access, security, distributed processing, and version control, as well as testing CNC configurations and controlling software deployment throughout the organisation. The candidate should have excellent verbal & written communication skills in English & proven analytical and problem-solving skills. The candidate will also need the ability to work in a remote team environment. Due to the requirement to support our clients in specific time zones, we are seeking appointment of candidates within the LatAm Region. Responsibilities: The CNC Consultant role is extremely broad, and responsibilities include (but are not limited to);
Oracle ERP (JD Edwards) System Administration, which includes Server and Application Administration, ERP Security Management at user and role level. Planning and installation of business application patches also called electronic software updates or ESUs as well as underlying foundational code or programs called tools releases or service packs Building and deploying changes to the business applications via package management. Management of various business environments & path codes like development, user acceptance testing (UAT) and production, making sure each environment has relevant privileges for users to work with objects in OMW along with required OCM Mapping and Datasources. Ability to Setup and Troubleshoot Printer configuration within JDE, Transform and Print Server Server Manager (the Tools Release 9.1 and above) system management console advance skills. Performance tuning of applications and web servers using Server Manager to analyze kernel processes and obtain log files for detailed analysis. Basic system auditing and performance tuning tasks. Development of software tools and processes to automate repetitive CNC tasks Refreshing and optimization of the underlying database, working with database administrators Experience/expertise with SQL databases such as Oracle, SQL Server with regards to EnterpriseOne Adherence to Redfaire and client Data Protection policies. Qualifications & Skills: Technical Experience: Minimum 6-7 Years of JDE CNC experience. Expertise in the technical architecture for EnterpriseOne (e.G. Citrix servers, WebLogic servers, WebSphere servers, deployment server, batch/enterprise servers, BSSV servers, mobile apps/AIS servers plus multiple OS's including Windows, Unix/Linux & AS400 can be advantageous) Experience in adding custom environments and custom datasource setups Knowledge of CNC mapping configuration changes using Object Configuration Manager (OCM) Expertise in multiple JDE system software configurations (multi-foundation), Tools Release Updates Relevant 3rd level qualification or equivalent. Excellent communication skills, both verbal & written. Technical competence with proven analytical skills. Problem solving and trouble shooting skills (which requires a wide range of skills beyond JDE CNC skills such as networking, storage, database, operating system, and virtual infrastructures and the ability to work with people who are experts in these areas) Systematic approach to problem resolution. Ability to work independently under one’s own initiative whilst being part of a global team. Proven ability to be adaptable and to respond to constantly changing demands. Ability to work under pressure & to prioritize. Recognise the importance of customer service and strive to deliver high standards. Working knowledge of Microsoft products such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook. What we offer: Career growth within an expanding global award-winning Oracle Partner recognised for excellence. Supportive team culture with ongoing training and mentorship. Competitive salary and benefits package. Opportunity to engage in flexible working arrangements, including remote options, to help you maintain a healthy work-life balance. Redfaire is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to building an integrative culture where everyone feels welcomed and supported. Our inclusive workplace provides an environment that will support your development no matter your gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

Proven experience handling legacy systems, codebase audits, or technical recovery scenarios. Solid understanding of application security best practices, including secure handling of sensitive data. Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to prioritize issues based on business impact. Experience collaborating with mobile teams (React Native is a plus). Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar! Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que: Contratação: CLT Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra. Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação. O que buscamos? Estamos em busca de um/uma Tech Lead para integrar nossa equipe de desenvolvimento. Quem ocupar essa posição desempenhará um papel crucial na liderança técnica, garantindo a entrega contínua de valor por meio da otimização do fluxo de valor (Value Stream) e da implementação de soluções de alta qualidade que estejam alinhadas aos objetivos de negócios dos nossos clientes. Como será seu dia-a-dia? Liderança técnica: Fornece liderança e orientação técnica à equipe de desenvolvimento, estabelecendo padrões de qualidade, aderindo às melhores práticas e garantindo a implementação de soluções técnicas eficientes e escaláveis;
Compreensão do fluxo de valor: Trabalha com gerentes de produto, analistas de negócios, arquitetos e desenvolvedores para entender o fluxo de valor completo, desde a concepção da ideia até a entrega do produto, identificando áreas de melhoria e reduzindo desperdícios no processo;
Colaboração com equipes multifuncionais: Trabalha em estreita colaboração com gerentes de produto, analistas de negócios, arquitetos e desenvolvedores para entender as necessidades dos negócios, traduzi-las em requisitos técnicos e garantir que as soluções propostas estejam alinhadas com os objetivos gerais do projeto e do cliente;
Gerenciamento de projetos e entregas: Monitora o progresso dos projetos, identifique gargalos e proponha soluções para garantir que os prazos e os padrões de qualidade sejam cumpridos. Além disso, coordene a implementação de práticas de CI/CD e automação para otimizar o processo de desenvolvimento e entrega;
Planejamentoe design técnico: Lidera o planejamento e o design técnico de projetos de integração e API, garantindo a aplicação de melhores práticas, reutilização e escalabilidade. Isto inclui a definição da arquitetura do sistema, a seleção de tecnologias e ferramentas e a identificação de riscos e oportunidades de melhoria;
Entrega contínua de valor: Monitora e otimize o fluxo de trabalho da equipe, garantindo a entrega contínua de valor para os clientes e partes interessadas, coordenando práticas de CI/CD e automação para otimizar o processo de desenvolvimento e entrega;
