title: Freight Desk Manager
description: Position Scope The Freight Desk Manager is a high-impact leadership role responsible for architecting and overseeing the logistics support function for non-finished goods on a global scale, with a dedicated focus on the LATAM region. This position operates at the intersection of global procurement and operational execution, managing a complex ecosystem of freight forwarders, control towers, and internal stakeholders. The mission is to ensure world-class shipment execution and financial integrity through robust audit structures and the expansion of logistics capabilities in high-growth markets. Responsibilities and Accountabilities Regional Strategy & Expansion: Serve as the primary architect for logistics operations in LATAM, including the enablement of Importer of Record (IOR) operations and regional supplier onboarding. Global Freight Desk Leadership: Lead the logistics support function for specialized shipments, managing a network of global freight forwarders operating through dedicated control towers. Rate Card Governance: Standardize and maintain global Bulk Air and Ocean rate cards across a diverse portfolio of international suppliers to ensure cost consistency and transparency. Strategic Sourcing: Lead RFQs and supplier onboarding initiatives for logistics, ensuring all partners meet global compliance and service level standards. Governance & Audit Architecture: Design and maintain a global freight audit strategy and control architecture to ensure financial discipline across high-volume global invoice environments. Control Tower Oversight: Drive operational excellence by governing forwarder performance, ensuring industry-leading on-time shipment execution across all transport modes. Automation & Process Engineering: Implement automated invoice approval systems and systemic controls to improve first-pass yield and overall operational efficiency. Stakeholder Management: Partner with global cross-functional teams to support non-standard logistics requirements and rapid-response delivery programs. Mandatory Requirements Experience: Extensive experience in Global Supply Management, Logistics Procurement, or Supply Chain Operations within multinational environments. Regional Expertise: Deep knowledge of the LATAM logistics landscape, including regulatory requirements, customs, and supplier networks. Procurement Mastery: Proven track record in leading RFQs and managing complex logistics supplier onboarding processes. Network Management: Experience managing large-scale global freight forwarder relationships and\ "Control Tower\" operationalmodels. Technical Proficiency: Strong background in Logistics Financial Control (Freight Audit) and managing high-volume, global-scale invoice environments. Leadership: Experience leading international teams and managing external providers across different time zones (APAC, EMEA, AMR). Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, International Trade, or a related field. Languages: Fluency in English is essential for regional and global coordination. Desirable Requirements Advanced Education: MBA or Master’s degree. Process Excellence: Certifications in Lean Six Sigma or similar experience. Digital Transformation: Experience implementing AI-driven or automated financial auditing and rate management tools. Rapid Growth Background: Experience managing logistics for hyper-growth programs (e.G., international express expansions or specialized delivery models).

title: Web Content Editor / Web Qa (Growth Role)
description: Location: Brazil Team: Digital / Web Company Description Bucksense, Inc. is a company dedicated to bridging the gap between brands and publishers by fostering an open and trustworthy environment. At Bucksense, we combine technology with human expertise to provide a unified platform for managing marketing operations effectively. Our mission is to deliver impactful results with efficiency and clarity. Role Overview We are seeking a digitally savvy, detail-oriented Web Content Editor with a strong interest in web quality assurance and UX excellence. This role sits at the intersection of editorial, web publishing, and QA, and is ideal for a mid-level professional who wants to grow into a QA leadership role over time. You will be responsible for ensuring that all web content across our travel portals is clear, accurate, consistent, accessible, and presented to a high standard, while also progressively taking ownership of content-related QA processes and cross-team quality checks. You will collaborate closely with content creators, designers, developers, and marketing teams to ensure a polished, high-quality web experience. Key Responsibilities: Content Editing & Publishing Edit, proofread, and publish web content to ensure clarity, accuracy, grammar, and alignment with brand guidelines. Maintain consistency in tone, style, formatting, and structure across pages. Manage and update content within a CMS (e.G., Sanity, WordPress, or similar). Coordinate content updates with writers, designers, developers, and stakeholders. Maintain an editorial calendar and oversee timely content updates. UX, Accessibility & Content Quality Review content presentation across devices to ensure usability, readability, and mobile optimization. Ensure accessibility best practices are followed (e.G., alt text, content structure, readability). Apply UX and SEO best practices, including internal linking and content optimization. Assess image quality, typography, layout, and overall visual presentation. Web QA & Quality Ownership Perform content-focused QA checks to ensure pages are published correctly and meet quality standards. Identify and flag content-related issues such as broken links, formatting errors, incorrect displays, or inconsistencies. Collaborate with developers and designers to resolve quality issues. Contribute to the development of QA standards, checklists, and processes related to web content. Gradually take increased ownership of web quality assurance as part of a long-term growth path toward QA leadership. Performance & Optimization Monitor website performance and user engagement using analytics tools (e.G., Google Analytics). Conduct regular content audits to identify outdated, underperforming, or improvement-ready content. Recommend enhancements based on data and qualitative review. Qualifications & Skills 2+ years of experience in digital content editing, web publishing, or content operations. Strong editorial skills: writing, editing, and proofreading with exceptional attention to detail. Hands-on experience working with CMS platforms (Sanity, WordPress, or headless CMS). Working knowledge of HTML/CSS for light formatting and layout adjustments. Solid understanding of UX principles, accessibility, and mobile-first web best practices. Comfort reviewing web pages for quality, consistency, and presentation issues. Experience using analytics tools to assess content performance. Organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple content workflows. Interest in growing into a broader QA-focused role over time. Nice to Have Prior exposure to web QA, content QA, or digital quality processes. Experience in travel, lifestyle, luxury, or e-commerce environments. Familiarity with structured QA documentation or checklists. Growth Opportunity This role is designed to evolve over time, with the opportunity to grow into a lead QA role for web content and digital experience, helping define standards and processes across our platforms.

plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery. Our mission is to deliver impactful results with efficiency and clarity. Role Overview We are seeking a digitally savvy, detail-oriented Web Content Editor with a strong interest in web quality assurance and UX excellence. This role sits at the intersection of editorial, web publishing, and QA, and is ideal for a mid-level professional who wants to grow into a QA leadership role over time. You will be responsible for ensuring that all web content across our travel portals is clear, accurate, consistent, accessible, and presented to a high standard, while also progressively taking ownership of content-related QA processes and cross-team quality checks. You will collaborate closely with content creators, designers, developers, and marketing teams to ensure a polished, high-quality web experience. Key Responsibilities: Content Editing & Publishing Edit, proofread, and publish web content to ensure clarity, accuracy, grammar, and alignment with brand guidelines. Maintain consistency in tone, style, formatting, and structure across pages. Manage and update content within a CMS (e.G., Sanity, WordPress, or similar). Coordinate content updates with writers, designers, developers, and stakeholders. Maintain an editorial calendar and oversee timely content updates. UX, Accessibility & Content Quality Review content presentation across devices to ensure usability, readability, and mobile optimization. Ensure accessibility best practices are followed (e.G., alt text, content structure, readability). Apply UX and SEO best practices, including internal linking and content optimization. Assess image quality, typography, layout, and overall visual presentation. Web QA & Quality Ownership Perform content-focused QA checks to ensure pages are published correctly and meet quality standards. Identify and flag content-related issues such as broken links, formatting errors, incorrect displays, or inconsistencies. Collaborate with developers and designers to resolve quality issues. Contribute to the development of QA standards, checklists, and processes related to web content. Gradually take increased ownership of web quality assurance as part of a long-term growth path toward QA leadership. Performance & Optimization Monitor website performance and user engagement using analytics tools (e.G., Google Analytics). Conduct regular content audits to identify outdated, underperforming, or improvement-ready content. Recommend enhancements based on data and qualitative review. Qualifications & Skills 2+ years of experience in digital content editing, web publishing, or content operations. Strong editorial skills: writing, editing, and proofreading with exceptional attention to detail. Hands-on experience working with CMS platforms (Sanity, WordPress, or headless CMS). Working knowledge of HTML/CSS for light formatting and layout adjustments. Solid understanding of UX principles, accessibility, and mobile-first web best practices. Comfort reviewing web pages for quality, consistency, and presentation issues. Experience using analytics tools to assess content performance. Organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple content workflows. Interest in growing into a broader QA-focused role over time. Nice to Have Prior exposure to web QA, content QA, or digital quality processes. Experience in travel, lifestyle, luxury, or e-commerce environments. Familiarity with structured QA documentation or checklists. Growth Opportunity This role is designed to evolve over time, with the opportunity to grow into a lead QA role for web content and digital experience, helping define standards and processes across our platforms.
